title: The Big Log
lines: Gus and Jen run in a pen.
A pup digs in the mud at a log.
"Bugs are in the mud," said Jen.
Gus and Jen tug at the log.
"We can not tug it up," said Gus.
"We can dig," said Jen. She digs and digs.
The log is up! Six bugs run in the mud.
Jen sets the log on the mud.
scoring_note: This passage says "can not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "can't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
